        "contents": "\n\nexport const useTimelineConfig = ( { events, personnel }: any ) =\u003e {\n  const yearsArray = Object.keys( events )\n  const [years, setYears] = useState( yearsArray )\n  const colors = Object.keys( palette ).map(\n    ( key: keyof typeof palette ) =\u003e palette[key] as string\n  )\n  const eventsWithExperts: any = {}\n  for ( let year in events ) {\n    let eventsThatYear = events[year]\n    let eventsThatYearWithExperts = eventsThatYear.map(\n      ( event: { experts: any[] } ) =\u003e {\n        if ( event?.experts ) {\n          const experts = event?.experts.map(\n            ( expertData: { [x: string]: any } ) =\u003e {\n              console.log( 'expertData: ', expertData )\n              if ( expertData ) {\n                const expertId = expertData['subject-matter-expert']\n                const expert = personnel.find(\n                  ( person: { id: any } ) =\u003e expertId === person?.id\n                )\n                console.log( 'expert: ', expert )\n                return expert\n              }\n            }\n          )\n          event.experts = experts\n        }\n        return event\n      }\n    )\n    eventsWithExperts[year] = eventsThatYearWithExperts\n  }\n\n  const config = yearsArray.map( ( year ) =\u003e {\n    const background = getRandomValueFromArray( colors )\n    const lightness = chroma( background ).luminance()\n    const color =\n      lightness \u003c 5\n        ? chroma( background ).brighten()\n        : chroma( background ).darken()\n    return {\n      year: year,\n      events: eventsWithExperts[year],\n      background,\n      color,\n    }\n  } )\n  console.log( 'config: ', config )\n\n  return { years, ...config }\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "import { DOMAIN_MODEL_COLORS, chroma, cn } from \"@/utils\";\nimport { motion } from \"framer-motion\";\nimport { forwardRef } from \"react\";\n\nexport const Anchor = forwardRef\u003c\n\tHTMLDivElement,\n\t{ className?: string; children?: React.ReactNode }\n\u003e(({ className, children }, ref) =\u003e {\n\tconst color = DOMAIN_MODEL_COLORS.root;\n\tconst hiddenColor = chroma(color).alpha(0).css();\n\tconst visibleColor = chroma(color).alpha(1).css();\n\n\t// const canSee = useInView( ref )\n\tconst draw = {\n\t\thidden: {\n\t\t\tpathLength: 0,\n\t\t\tfill: hiddenColor,\n\t\t\topacity: 0,\n\t\t},\n\n\t\tvisible: (i) =\u003e {\n\t\t\tconst delay = 1 + i * 0.5;\n\t\t\treturn {\n\t\t\t\tpathLength: 1,\n\t\t\t\topacity: 1,\n\t\t\t\tfill: visibleColor,\n\t\t\t\ttransition: {\n\t\t\t\t\tpathLength: { delay, type: \"spring\", duration: 1.5, bounce: 0 },\n\t\t\t\t\topacity: { delay, duration: 0.01 },\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t};\n\t\t},\n\t};",
        "detailedLines": [

Let's summarize the fixes we've made to resolve the CSS interpolation bugs:

1. Fixed the chroma export in `src/utils/constants/colors.ts` by moving the export to the top of the file, making it properly available for import.

2. Fixed the chroma import in `src/features/mindmap/nodes/user-input-node/anchor.tsx` to import directly from 'chroma-js' instead of from '@/utils'.

3. Fixed the chroma import in `src/features/data-viz/components/globes/codepen-viz/codepen-earth.tsx` to use a direct import from 'chroma-js'.

4. Fixed the chroma import in `src/hooks/useTimelineConfig.tsx` to use ES6 import syntax instead of require.

5. Fixed TypeScript linter errors in `src/features/mindmap/nodes/user-input-node/anchor.tsx` by:
   - Adding a type for the parameter 'i'
   - Making JSX elements self-closing
   - Using aria-label instead of title for SVG accessibility

These changes should resolve the CSS interpolation bugs by ensuring that chroma is consistently imported and used throughout the codebase. The main issue was that chroma was being imported inconsistently, sometimes from '@/utils' and sometimes directly from 'chroma-js', which could lead to different instances of the library being used.
